{{Quote|There was no danger. Humans need movement to see. Not-moving shadows are of no concern.|Unidentified Defel|<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
The '''Defel''' (colloquially known as '''Wraiths''') were barely visible beings native to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]] who appeared to most other species as shadows, re-enforcing the misconception that they were chameleon-like beings or "living shadows".

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Shoto_Eyefire_and_consort.png|thumb|left|250px|A male and female Defel.]]

Defel were from [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]], a large, high-gravity, seldom-visited world orbiting the [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] [[Wikipedia: supergiant|supergiant]] [[Ka'Dedus]]. Since Af'El had no [[Ozone/Legends|ozone layer]], ultraviolet light passed freely to the surface, while other light wavelengths were mostly blocked by the heavy gases in the planet's atmosphere. Thus, all lifeforms on Af'El could see in ultraviolet light ranges, but were blinded by all but the dimmest light in other wavelengths. Accordingly, Defels normally wore a visor when they left Af'El, and expected to be exposed to daylight at their destination. Compared to other species, they could see exceptionally well in the dark.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" />

Defel were short, stocky beings, averaging 1.3 meters tall and nearly as wide. Though they were nearly invisible in normal light, Defel were actually colorful beings. Viewed under ultraviolet light, their fur appeared in colors ranging from yellow to blue. Their snouts appeared green, with orange, gill-like slits at the base of their jawlines.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> Elderly Defel lost their ability to absorb light, fading to a dull dark brown under visible light.<ref name="Official Tournament Sealed Deck">{{CCG|set=Official Tournament Sealed Deck|cardname=Arleil Schous}}</ref>

==Common Defel names==
*Dourlas<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
*Freel<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
*Gr'vesh<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
*Yarchur<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
*Bobrral

==Society and culture==
Due to the harsh conditions of Af'El, Defel had a society based on communal resource sharing. Co-operation was vital for survival. As a result, the typical Defel was a tough, independent being, with a strong sense of honor. Defel stood by their word, and refused to associate with anyone who broke a promise. The Defel lived in underground cities to escape Af'El's violent storms. Their subterranean society had developed highly advanced mining and [[Metallurgy/Legends|metallurgical]] technology, though they had not developed space travel or agriculture on their own.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" />

==Defel in the galaxy==
[[File:Defel.png|thumb|left|An elderly Defel.]]
Their homeworld was seldom visited due to the difficulty of escaping its gravity well, making Defel rare outside of the [[Ka'Dedus system/Legends|Ka'Dedus system]]. This rarity, combined with their unusual abilities, meant that much of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] believed they were mythical or supernatural beings. Some of the few Defel who left their homeworld went in search of adventure, and often employed their natural stealth abilities to become [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], bodyguards, or thieves.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> Most Defel who left Af'El, however, were prized more for their skills in metallurgy, and were contracted by smelting operations and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturers.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

The Defel did see some trade in [[Meleenium/Legends|meleenium]], a rare substance used in [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] production, which was only found naturally on Af'El. During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] era, [[Vulca Minerals]] sent one ship a year to the Defel to trade fresh food for meleenium.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> [[Za]] served on the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends#The .22Council of Blood.22|Interim Ruling Council]].<ref name="Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood">''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood]]''</ref>

[[File:Defel_arleil.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[Arleil Schous/Legends|Arleil Schous]] at the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].]]

During the [[Dark Nest Crisis]], a young Defel underwent [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] training at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>
